info.title: About the numbers
items: “Affected” means social-media users who spend at least {threshold} a day in feeds. Individual daily times are assumed to vary exponentially around each country’s average.
Country averages are weekly times from Q4 2025 (video excluded). {share} of each population is assumed to use social media.
Generations are counted as of {year}. Age structure, user rates and the weighting by generation are rough global estimates, with US device data as a guide.
Health issues come from EU adolescents and are projected onto ages 10–19 in every country, using a modelled spread of weekend screen time.
Reasons come from a global survey of internet users aged 16–64. Multiple answers were possible.
All figures are estimates, not measurements.
